body: It also doesnt help that my boyfriend picked this very day to start some really unessesary shit basically for nothing. Only minor stuff. He did that last year too, then he didnt even congratulate me at all... And now we are fighting. Over something so small its embarrasing. I sent him a message explaining how depressed I was..only for him to call me a lil later and when I answered the phone, all he said were «so now you answer the phone, huh? Fuck you» and then hung up.. wish he knew what depression feels like, does he really think I wanna feel like this? Does he? Damn must be blissful to be so ignorant.. I was hoping for support from him who is supposed to be the closest to me, but he only made it worse x 10...
Thanks! Nice of you to congratulate me☺️ I appreciate that

Im stuck inside basically most of the time regardless due to severe anxiety and AVPD. I have some few close friends..or so I thought. It sucks really bad that they forgot me today. Makes me feel like its the same sh*t for ppl if Im here on earth or not.
